stories.name: Rakdos Cackler
stories.intro: A devil with knives for fingers capers along a rooftop, cackling. It drops in front of you, blades clattering. It will not hold back, and it does not care to block.
stories.win: The cackler giggles and drums its blades in your honour. It is yours now.
stories.lose: Its blades make music on you.
stories.flee: You run, and its laughter follows you down the street.

stories.name: Rakdos Shred-Freak
stories.intro: A Rakdos shred-freak is muttering about where the soul is kept. She is on you before you see her, knife out. She means to look behind your gallbladder.
stories.win: She decides your soul can stay where it is and follows you. She is yours now.
stories.lose: Her knife gets close enough to start the search.
stories.flee: You run before she finds out.

stories.name: Dreadbore
stories.title: Part of the show
stories.text: In a Rakdos-held square, a ringmaster calls for a body for the next act. A pit of churning shadow waits at the centre of the stage. In this neighbourhood, everyone is part of the show.

outcome.text: The ringmaster cheers your cruelty and gives you the spell that opens the pit.
The ringmaster sends his performer to drag you to the pit.
You push through the crowd and lose your purse on the way.

stories.name: Carnival Hellsteed
stories.intro: A skeletal horse bursts from the carnival tent, its mane on fire. It favours candied hands and sweet hearts. It is on you before the music stops, and it bites first.
stories.win: The hellsteed snorts embers and lets you climb on. It is yours now.
stories.lose: It tramples you into the sawdust.
stories.flee: You roll under a wagon as it gallops past.

stories.name: Rakdos Guildgate
stories.text: A gate hung with chains and carnival lanterns marks the way into a Rakdos district. You can claim it for a tile you have walked.
